title: Raid plan catalog
loadError: The catalog could not be loaded: {message}
intro: Mobs (adds, council members, trash) that can be tanked or marked in a raid plan, and spells that are handed out as assignments. The defaults come from the code and can be overridden, hidden or reset here; own entries are added to them. A plan keeps the name and icon of an entry, so it still shows it after it was deleted.
hideText: The default entry leaves the lists. "Restore" brings it back; plans that use it keep showing it.
deleteText: Plans that use the entry keep showing the remembered name and icon.
bossHint: An add shows up as a tank target in this boss's raid plan by itself.
classesHint: The suggestions and the pre-selection come from the classes of the spells of a type.
iconHintMob: Wowhead icon name (e.g. spell_fire_flamebolt) or boss:<encounter id>; empty = the generic enemy icon.
